title: Lifting a reduced split right-exact sequence in a projective class
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and I an ideal. Let P be a class of projective R-modules, closed under binary sums and summands, meaning that for every isomorphism P12 ≅ P1 × P2, (P1 belongs to P and P12 belongs to P) if and only if (P1 belongs to P and P2 belongs to P), and suppose maps between class members which are surjective after extension of scalars to R/I are surjective. Let S = (P1 -> P2 -> M) be a right-exact sequence with P1 and P2 in P. Suppose extension of scalars of S to R/I admits a splitting and M/IM is isomorphic to T/IT for some T in P. Then S is short exact and M belongs to P.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 0BCA, final split-injectivity paragraph (step 5)

proof.text: Lift the reduced projection P2/IP2 -> T/IT to a map g : P2 -> T by projectivity of P2. The class-surjectivity hypothesis makes g surjective. Split g by projectivity of T. Its kernel U belongs to the class by the summand condition.

The composite P1 -> P2 -> U is invertible modulo I. It is surjective by the class-surjectivity hypothesis and splits because U is projective. Its kernel V belongs to the class, and reduction of the split sequence shows V/IV = 0.

Zero belongs to the class as a summand of P1. Apply the surjectivity condition to zero -> V to get V = 0. The composite P1 -> U is therefore invertible, giving a retraction of P1 -> P2. Thus the given right-exact sequence is short exact and split. Its last object belongs to the class by the summand condition.

theorem projective_class_reduced_splitting
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (Pclass : Set (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
    (hproj : ∀ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass → Projective P)
    (hclosed : ∀ P₁ P₂ P₁₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R,
      Nonempty (P₁₂ ≅ ModuleCat.of R (P₁ × P₂)) →
      (P₁ ∈ Pclass ∧ P₁₂ ∈ Pclass ↔ P₁ ∈ Pclass ∧ P₂ ∈ Pclass))
    (hsurj : ∀ (P₁ P₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (f : P₁ ⟶ P₂),
      P₁ ∈ Pclass → P₂ ∈ Pclass →
      Function.Surjective ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).map f) →
      Function.Surjective f)
    (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R))
    (hexact : S.Exact) (hepi : Epi S.g)
    (hfirst : S.X₁ ∈ Pclass) (hmiddle : S.X₂ ∈ Pclass)
    (hsplit : Nonempty ((S.map (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).Splitting))
    (hlast : ∃ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass ∧
      Nonempty ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj S.X₃ ≅
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj P)) :
    S.ShortExact ∧ S.X₃ ∈ Pclass
